preserved_results: The frozen R3 cost layer is untouched: BeH2 remains the only bank this repository has priced, and h4_converged remains exact-tier right-censored at the 65536 endpoint.

The QR3b preflight's rejection of LiH at its intrinsic stopping point stands as recorded. This screen does not overturn it; it reports that the same instance is admissible under a different, separately declared stopping rule.

estimand.name: R3S_candidate_admission_under_a_declared_priceability_screen
estimand.question: Which candidate instances does this declared screen admit for a sampling probe -- that is, which clear the accuracy target with the declared margin at a word universe below the ceiling QR3b calibrated? The screen ranks candidates for probe spending; it does not determine which instances are priceable.
estimand.why_it_exists: The QR3b preflight recorded screen_would_have_rejected_before_probe: true -- its word-universe gate was evaluated after the 2+2 probe had already run all forty cells. This producer evaluates the same gate before any sampling, over every declared candidate, so that a probe is spent only on a candidate that can pass it.

selection_rule.name: smallest_prefix_clearing_the_accuracy_margin
selection_rule.statement: Walk the frozen A-CASE greedy ordering from its shortest non-trivial prefix and stop at the smallest prefix whose exact subspace bias is at or below accuracy_target_millihartree / margin_factor. The rule is a function of the accuracy target alone.
selection_rule.contrast_rule: intrinsic_stop -- the greedy's own predicted-lowering threshold, which is the rule the frozen R2b/R3/QR3b records used.
selection_rule.minimum_prefix_size_basis: A one-generator prefix is the identity alone, so its Ritz value is the Hartree-Fock reference energy and its span is not a subspace. It is excluded by declaration rather than by outcome; on LiH it would otherwise clear the unmargined target at W=193.
selection_rule.mapping_neutrality: The prefix is chosen from the source-side bias only, which the linear encoding family leaves invariant (section 6.2). No mapping, arm, word universe, or setting count enters the choice; the record reports the per-arm bias agreement at the chosen prefix so that the claim is checked rather than asserted.
selection_rule.ordering_provenance: The greedy ordering is not re-derived here. It is read from the frozen selected_labels each candidate's own preregistration already fixed, so a prefix of it is a prefix of the recorded run.

acceptance_gates.margin_factor_basis: The shot-search pass rule bounds replica RMSE against the exact reference, and RMSE combines bank bias with sampling scatter in quadrature. A bank sitting at the target has no allowance left for shot noise at any endpoint, so the margin exists to reserve the target for the statistical component. At margin 3 the bias takes 0.533 mHa, which is (1/3)^2 = 11.1 percent of the MSE budget, and the statistical RMSE allowance falls from 1.6 to 1.5085 mHa -- a 5.7 percent reduction. Those are two different fractions and the smaller one is not a share of a shot budget consumed. Note what this argument does and does not do: it motivates having a margin, and it does not pick 3 out of 2 or 5. See margin_factor_status.
acceptance_gates.word_universe_ceiling_basis: Carried forward in intent from the QR3b preregistration: BeH2 is the only bank that has ever priced inside this grid, at W=1814 on its full-width arms, and the ceiling is the next power of two above it. This is an operational admission threshold calibrated on one success, not a demonstrated necessary condition for priceability -- coefficient magnitudes, grouping, estimator variance and pencil conditioning all bear on whether a bank resolves, and W is a proxy for the reconstruction variance the shot search has to overcome rather than that variance itself. What supports it is that both banks rejected so far, h4_converged at W=7926 and LiH at its intrinsic stop at W=7740, sit about four times above it.
acceptance_gates.binding_arm_rule: max over the declared mapping arms. A candidate passes only if its widest arm fits; the reduced +2q arms have been strictly smaller on every committed instance, but that is an observation, not a guarantee, so the maximum is taken rather than assumed.
acceptance_gates.word_universe_convention_basis: The tree carries two conventions differing by one: mapping_axis counts the identity word (BeH2 full-width 1815), protocol_axis and the QR3b probe do not (1814). The ceiling was calibrated in the second, and the identity is the one word a shot budget never buys -- its expectation is fixed by normalization -- so it contributes nothing to the reconstruction variance the ceiling stands in for. The screen counts as protocol_axis does, and check_priceability_screen.py calibrates against that record rather than mapping_axis.
acceptance_gates.margin_factor_status_basis: This config and the first result it produces enter the repository in the same commit, so factor 3 is not preregistered with respect to this run and the LiH admission is exploratory evidence for the rule rather than a test of it. Recording that plainly is cheaper than the alternative, which would be to claim a preregistration the history does not support. Two things limit the damage. Every candidate's margin_sensitivity records the range of margin factors over which its verdict is unchanged, re-derived from the walked rows, so a reader can see whether the verdict turns on the number at all. And the rule is frozen from this commit onward: the preregistered use is the next candidate screened under it.

omitted_candidates.h4: The frozen budget-8 H4 bank's labels are the first nine of h4_converged's, so over any shared prefix the two banks are the same object and h4_converged's walked rows are h4's own. That walk leaves the ceiling at M=3, inside h4's ordering and without having cleared the margin, and W is non-decreasing along a prefix, so every h4 prefix from M=3 on is above the ceiling whatever its bias does. Screening h4 separately would re-walk the same rows to the same verdict. check_priceability_screen.py re-derives all of that from the frozen label lists and the walked rows rather than taking it on trust.

claim_boundary: Structural scope-decision evidence only. Every quantity here is a bias or a word count computed in deterministic double-precision arithmetic -- dense eigensolves and exact operator algebra, reproducible run to run on fixed BLAS threading, but floating-point and compared to tolerance by the checker, not exact arithmetic. Nothing is sampled. The screen may authorize or withhold a sampling probe on a candidate. It may not price C(epsilon), answer QR3 or QR3b, or reclassify any frozen censoring decision. Candidates are admitted or rejected *under this declared screen*: admission is not a demonstration that a bank will resolve, and rejection is not a demonstration that it cannot -- the ceiling is an operational threshold calibrated on a single priced bank, and the frozen R3 cost layer already records that clearing a gate is necessary for a price without being sufficient for one.
